name: Can I replace mobile home wall panels with standard drywall?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace mobile home wall panels with standard drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can replace modular vinyl-coated wall panels with standard drywall, but it requires careful preparation. Mobile homes typically have thinner stud framing and subtle movement during seasonal temperature shifts. To upgrade, a contractor must assess the existing wall framing, reinforce studs where necessary, and install lightweight or standard drywall with proper taping and mudding. HH Remodeling LLC manages the entire process from framing adjustments through finish painting, giving the interior a solid, modern residential look instead of visible panel seams and plastic battens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Upgrading requires checking the existing framing, reinforcing studs if needed, and hanging, taping, and painting standard drywall for a seamless look.
